oracle_authority: unmodified public canonicalFactory285 from an immutable noisemaker-for-cpu snapshot, executed through the pinned bindCanonicalKernel/GlslCpuRuntime/runPass path; no C++ output participates

aspectRatio.numeric_contract: plain JS Number -- a double, NEVER narrowed to f32

globalCoord.numeric_contract: Float32Array -- every lane store narrows to f32
globalCoord.write_expression: globalCoord[0] = gl_FragCoord[0] + tileOffset[0], globalCoord[1] = gl_FragCoord[1] + tileOffset[1]

mutable_global_contracts.shadowed_binding: createCanonicalBindings supplies an unrelated `aspectRatio` uniform. The factory-scope `var aspectRatio` shadows it and the binding is never read; the generator fails closed if the factory ever reads $bindings["aspectRatio"].

exactness_contract.float32: complete raw little-endian uint32 lane arrays; signed zero and NaN payloads are significant
exactness_contract.rgba8: complete independently captured canonical Surface.toRgba8 byte arrays; never reconstructed from expected words
exactness_contract.comparison_order: dimensions, exact expected/actual lane count, exact expected/actual byte count, every Float32 word, every independent RGBA8 byte
exactness_contract.coordinates: all stored rows and first mismatches use top-down storage order and top-down x/y
exactness_contract.alpha: every output alpha float word is exactly 0x3f800000 and every RGBA8 alpha byte is exactly 255

render_cases.name: shape-landscape-16x9
coverage: Metal aspect quotient 16 * rcp(9) is exactly f32-representable
wrap false with integral lf (wrap-invariant witness)

render_cases.name: shape-crop-1280x720
coverage: tile route at a production-shaped resolution

render_cases.name: shape-square-12
coverage: Metal aspect quotient 12 * rcp(12) is 1 + 2^-25, not exactly f32-representable

render_cases.name: shape-portrait-9x16
coverage: non-reaching control for shape-aspect-f32-narrowed with a different shape than square

render_cases.name: shape-zero-speeds
coverage: aspectRatio is written and never read

render_cases.name: shape-wrap-live-37-61
coverage: the only case where the wrap axis is live (non-integral lf)

render_cases.name: shape-negative-speeds
coverage: both speeds negative (the speedA<0 / speedB<0 arms)

render_cases.name: shape-extreme-tile-offset
coverage: the only case that discriminates shape-globalcoord-unnarrowed
Metal aspect quotient 16 * rcp(12) is exactly f32-representable, so shape-aspect-f32-narrowed cannot discriminate

production_shaped_case.note: The full 1280x720 route is rendered in memory and discarded; storing all 3,686,400 Float32 lanes is not viable, but the proof needs only the 40x24 window, which is stored above and re-derived against the tile array by the materializer. st = globalCoord / fullResolution[1] is two orders of magnitude larger here than in the 11x9 proof, so a translation defect that only appears at large fullResolution is caught by this case.

controls.name: external-pass-extreme
controls.note: the factory reads $bindings time/seed only; runPass context time/seed are never consumed

controls.name: bound-time-ten
controls.note: bound time is live through the speedA/speedB offset terms

controls.name: bound-seed-123
controls.note: measured invariant at defines 40/30; see seed_liveness_census. seed remains a required int32 ABI binding

controls.name: bound-wrap-true
controls.note: lf = map(loopAScale=1, 1, 100, 6, 1) = 6.0 is already integral, so floor(lf) is a no-op; see wrap_liveness_census and shape-wrap-live-37-61 for the live half of this pair

consumers: offset(): the 300..380 arm forwards seedVal into value(...) as st + seedVal
randomFromLatticeWithOffset(): the scalar uint XOR sites at normalized 97, 98, 99
value(): the interp == 10 and interp == 11 arms
seed_liveness_census.reason: At defines LOOP_A_OFFSET=40 / LOOP_B_OFFSET=30 the only main() consumers of the `seed` uniform are the two offset(...) calls. Offset 40 selects the `loopOffset >= 40 && loopOffset <= 120` arm, which dispatches shape(st, sides, freq*0.5) and never reads seedVal; offset 30 selects the absolute-distance arm, which also never reads seedVal. Every seed consumer listed above sits behind the 300..380 arm, which these defines do not select.
seed_liveness_census.design_agreement: shape-design.md section 4.2 records bound `seed` as proven invariant at 40/30 and explicitly instructs this package NOT to require it to differ. The eight probes above are the measurement backing that instruction.

wrap_liveness_census.rule: wrap only reaches the output through `lf = floor(lf)`. It is inert wherever lf = map(loopScale, 1, 100, 6, 1) is already integral and live wherever it is not.

speed_sign_census.rule: the speedA and speedB sign/zero arms are pairwise distinct; a collapsed arm is a stop condition

globalcoord_witness_census.rule: the f32-lane contract on globalCoord is only observable where gl_FragCoord.xy + tileOffset leaves the exactly-representable f32 range; ordinary tile offsets leave it unwitnessed

globalcoord_native_binding_witness.classification: instrumented canonical-JS probe factory; NOT a parity array and never compared to a rendered shade
globalcoord_native_binding_witness.lane_order: top-down raster order; two lanes per pixel, globalCoord.x then globalCoord.y
globalcoord_native_binding_witness.purpose: answers the open question in shape-design.md section 12: whether the extreme tile offset is expressible end-to-end through the C++ binding ABI

mutation_ledger.name: shape-aspect-f32-narrowed
mutation_ledger.target: the `aspectRatio` write in main(): a plain JS Number (double), never narrowed to f32
mutation_ledger.contract: aspectRatio is a double; a port that types it float diverges
mutation_ledger.reaching: cases whose Metal aspect quotient is not exactly f32-representable AND that reach an aspectRatio read

mutation_ledger.name: shape-globalcoord-unnarrowed
mutation_ledger.target: the globalCoord / fullResolution[1] division in main(): its Metal-division dividend is the f32 globalCoord lane
mutation_ledger.contract: globalCoord lanes are f32; a port that divides the double gl_FragCoord + tileOffset by the same Metal reciprocal diverges
mutation_ledger.reaching: only tile offsets that push gl_FragCoord.xy + tileOffset out of the exactly-representable range

mutation_discrimination_contract.rule: discrimination is frozen and validated PER CASE AND PER MUTANT. Two cases with the same aspect ratio can differ in whether they discriminate, so a per-mutant summary is not sufficient and is never accepted here. A case that flips is a stop condition.
mutation_discrimination_contract.disjoint_witness_requirement: The two mutants must have DISJOINT witness sets. `aspectRatio` and `globalCoord` carry different numeric contracts, and a case that witnesses both could not attribute a divergence to one of them. This is enforced, not merely observed: the materializer rejects the document if any case appears in both witness sets.

claim_boundaries.dead_hash_branch: With defines 40/30 the randomFromLatticeWithOffset body, its three scalar uint XOR sites, and the circles/rings/diamonds/value arms are conservative call-graph reachable but are not entered by a normal full render. These full-surface cases must never be cited as proof that any of them executed.
claim_boundaries.normalized_source: Normalized/typed source, function, interface, and whole-program hashes are the frontend profiles’ authority and are deliberately not restated here.
claim_boundaries.bound_seed: The bound `seed` uniform is a required int32 ABI binding but is pixel-inert at the default defines; see seed_liveness_census. It is recorded as proven invariant, not waived.
claim_boundaries.bound_wrap: The bound `wrap` uniform is live only where lf is non-integral. Exactly one case witnesses the live half; see wrap_liveness_census.
claim_boundaries.globalcoord_lane_contract: The globalCoord f32-lane contract is witnessed by exactly one render case, shape-extreme-tile-offset. It is NOT a structural-only claim: the case is expressible end-to-end through the C++ binding ABI, and globalcoord_native_binding_witness carries the per-pixel lane words phase 2 must reproduce.
claim_boundaries.production_crop_full_route: shape-crop-1280x720 exercises the tileOffset rule at 1280x720 but its full route is not stored; the translation proof is carried by shape-wrap-live-37-61.
